cases.doc: The requested amount is larger than `terms.max_amount`.
cases.name: AmountExceedsMax

cases.doc: The recipient is this contract, which would lock the funds.
cases.name: InvalidRecipient

udt_struct_v0.doc: The terms a payer signs. Field names are sorted, so the XDR form is an `ScMap` whose keys appear\nin exactly this order.
udt_struct_v0.name: UptoTerms

fields.doc: Last ledger (inclusive) at which the terms may be settled. Clients set it equal to the\nauthorization entry's `signatureExpirationLedger`.
fields.name: expiration_ledger

fields.doc: The only address allowed to choose the amount and submit the settlement.
fields.name: facilitator

fields.doc: Upper bound on the amount, in atomic units of `token`. Must be positive.
fields.name: max_amount

fields.doc: Receiver of the funds (`G\xe2\x80\xa6` account or `C\xe2\x80\xa6` contract).
fields.name: recipient

fields.doc: SEP-41 token contract (a Stellar Asset Contract or a custom token).
fields.name: token

fields.doc: First ledger at which the terms may be settled. Clients normally send 0.
fields.name: valid_after_ledger

event_v0.doc: Emitted once per successful settlement, including zero-amount settlements.\nTopics: `["upto_settled", payer, recipient]`; data: a map of the remaining fields.
event_v0.name: UptoSettled

function_v0.doc:
Settles `amount` (`0..=terms.max_amount`) from `payer` to `terms.recipient` and returns it.

Requires the payer's authorization of `settle(terms)` with the single `approve` child
described in the crate documentation, and `terms.facilitator`'s authorization of
`settle(payer, terms, amount)`. Any error rolls back the whole invocation, including the
payer's nonce.
function_v0.name: settle
